title: Social media app frontend with Internet Identity auth, feed, post creation, and profile

requirements.summary: Add Internet Identity sign-in UI and ensure no standalone signup form is shown while relying on automatic profile creation on first login.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can sign in using Internet Identity.
On first successful sign-in, the backend creates a user record for the principal without requiring any extra user input.
On subsequent sign-ins, the existing user record is reused.
The UI does not include a standalone signup/registration form.

file_operations.description: Create an auth gating wrapper that uses the selected component "authorization" (Internet Identity via the provided auth hook) to require login before showing application data; show a clear logged-out screen with a single sign-in action. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a reusable login/logout button using the selected component "authorization" guidance (Internet Identity login/clear patterns) and ensure logout clears cached app data (React Query cache). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a React Query hook that fetches the current user's profile after authentication (using getCallerUserProfile) and exposes stable loading flags to avoid UI flashing; do not introduce any signup form—treat missing profile as a backend concern and proceed with sensible UI defaults. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire AuthGate and LoginButton into the app shell so the signed-out state blocks access to the feed/profile/create views and the signed-in state proceeds without any separate registration route or form.

requirements.summary: Implement a guided Create Post view with caption input and optional single image/video upload, with client-side validation and server error display.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in user can open a “Create Post” view and submit caption-only posts.
A signed-in user can attach a single media file and submit it with the post.
The UI shows client-side validation (e.g., file type/size) before upload and displays server errors if returned.
After successful post creation, the user is returned to the feed and sees the new post.

file_operations.description: Create the Create Post page with a simple form (caption + optional file picker). Use the selected component "blob-storage" (ExternalBlob.fromBytes + withUploadProgress) to prepare uploads and show progress, and use shadcn-ui form primitives (e.g., Button/Input/Textarea/Card) for accessible UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a mutation hook that calls the backend capability to create a post (createPost) with optional ExternalBlob; map backend errors to user-friendly English messages and invalidate/refetch the feed query on success. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement client-side validation helpers for a single selected media file (allowed MIME types image/* and video/* as configured by the backend, and a practical max size). Return validation messages for display in the form.
Register navigation to the Create Post view from the main navigation and ensure successful post creation returns the user to the feed route.

requirements.summary: Build the main feed view that lists newest posts first with caption, author, timestamp, and inline media rendering for images/videos, including loading/empty/error states.
acceptanceCriteria: The home/feed view loads posts from the backend and renders them in reverse chronological order.
Posts with images render a responsive image preview.
Posts with videos render an HTML5 video player with play/pause controls.
Loading, empty-state, and error states are present and readable in English.

file_operations.description: Create the Feed page that fetches all posts (getAllPosts), sorts by timestamp descending if needed, and renders a list with readable loading/error/empty states. Use the selected component "blob-storage" capability (ExternalBlob.getDirectURL) to render attached media via or

Create a PostCard component to display caption, author (principal string or derived handle if available), formatted timestamp, and inline media. Use shadcn-ui Card/Typography primitives for consistent layout. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a React Query hook for loading the feed (getAllPosts), with retry strategy appropriate for auth-related traps and a stable query key for invalidation after new post creation.
Add the generated empty-state illustration asset at the exact path frontend/public/assets/generated/empty-feed-illustration.dim_1200x600.png and reference it from the Feed empty-state UI.
Wire the Feed page as the primary signed-in route and ensure navigation highlights/returns correctly after creating a post.

requirements.summary: Implement signed-in user profile view/edit: show identity, edit display name and bio, and show the user’s post list/count.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in user can view their profile information.
A signed-in user can update display name and bio, and changes persist after refresh/sign-out/sign-in.
Profile view shows the user’s posts (or a filtered list) and a post count.

file_operations.description: Create the Profile page for the current user: display principal-derived identity info, load current profile (getCallerUserProfile) and the user’s posts (getUserPosts for the current principal), show a post count, and provide an edit form for display name and bio. Use shadcn-ui form components for accessibility. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add hooks/mutations to load the caller profile and update it (updateProfile and/or saveCallerUserProfile as appropriate to the backend interface), then refresh profile and post queries after updates.
Create a small profile header component to present display name/handle/bio and the principal in a user-friendly way (English labels), with clear edit affordances and focus states.
Register the Profile route in the main navigation and ensure it is only accessible when authenticated via AuthGate.

requirements.summary: Apply a warm neutral visual theme with consistent typography/spacing and obvious navigation between Feed, Create Post, and Profile.
acceptanceCriteria: App uses a consistent warm neutral color palette (e.g., off-white, charcoal, coral/amber accents) and consistent typography across pages.
Navigation between Feed, Create Post, and Profile is obvious and consistent.
All user-facing text is in English and components have clear focus/hover states.

file_operations.description: Adjust global styles to a warm neutral palette (off-white backgrounds, charcoal text, amber/coral accents), set consistent typography defaults, and ensure visible focus/hover states while keeping the UI simple and accessible.
Update Tailwind theme tokens (colors, radius, typography) to support the warm neutral design system consistently across components without introducing blue/purple as primary accents.

Create a shared layout with a clear top bar and/or bottom nav linking Feed, Create Post, and Profile, plus a consistent content container and spacing. Use shadcn-ui primitives for navigation buttons/structure where appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add the generated logo asset at the exact path frontend/public/assets/generated/logo-mark.dim_512x512.png and wire it into the app layout (e.g., header/brand mark).
Wire AppLayout around Feed/Create/Profile routes and ensure navigation is consistent and obvious on all pages, with English labels and accessible interactions.
